resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says log cupola cabin; the Weebly list says log cabin with cupola; Idaho Fire Lookouts says cupola log cabin. All describe one cabin, so the story uses the Weebly wording.

notes_for_editor: Timeline (camp 1920, cabin 1922, tower 1940, destroyed 1970) agrees across firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Weebly list. No source describes what remains on the site, so the story says so. The Witt names come from firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; the Idaho page gives the name as Joe A Witt with no citation. Two other records named Little Baldy exist in data/towers/id (us-id-little-baldy-2 and -3, both gone); they may be duplicates to check. A different Little Baldy in Idaho County (firelookout.com/id/littlebaldy.html, Nez Perce National Forest) is a separate tower and was not used. Elevation 5558 ft appears on both pages, but the Linfor Hill page shows the same figure, so it was not used.
